thesis: Selected advice for uncertainty focuses on building capabilities and relationships before a specific opportunity is clear.
summary: The reviewed passages recommend skill development, an audience, and a network as forms of capacity. The creator uses a batting metaphor for readiness when an opportunity arrives. These are proposed ways to increase options, not proof that all learning pays or that attention will convert to purchases.
